content:
Overview

Irkutsk is a city in Irkutsk Oblast with a population of 620,000. The cultural capital of Eastern Siberia, a historic city near Lake Baikal with beautiful wooden architecture and a vibrant Decembrist heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
